name: Layla Del Razo
bio:
Layla del Razo is a Mexican actress known for her work in film and audiovisual productions. Her performances are characterized by an expressive and emotionally driven approach, with a particular interest in portraying complex characters and exploring their psychological and interpersonal dimensions. Through her work, she has become part of a new generation of Mexican performers working across contemporary independent cinema.

Her work in Abeja Voladora reflects an interest in demanding dramatic material and characters whose motivations evolve throughout a story. Working closely with the film’s director and creative team, Del Razo contributed to the development of Ramona’s emotional and psychological complexity, balancing vulnerability, determination, and intensity within the character’s journey.

As an actress, Del Razo continues to develop her career within Mexico’s film and audiovisual landscape, collaborating with emerging filmmakers and creative teams while exploring different genres, characters, and forms of cinematic storytelling.

credits.title: The Last Goodbye
credits.overview: Paula, a lonely girl, lives with her older sister, who cares for her seriously ill mother. In the turmoil of her family's critical situation, Paula imagines a girl identical to herself who will help her face her reality and get closer to her mother before it's too late.
